seo.title: IRVE EV charger installation in the Alpes-Maritimes | Soliance
seo.description: 7 to 22 kW charger installed by our IRVE-qualified electricians and driven by your solar production. Home, condominium, business: fixed quote within 48 h.

hero.title: Charge at home, <highlight>in the sun</highlight> or at night.
hero.lead: A 7 to 22 kW charger installed by our IRVE-qualified electricians, driven by your solar production when you have it. Fixed quote, Consuel included, commissioning and handover on installation day.
hero.imageAlt: Wallbox on a post in front of a stone wall, electric vehicle charging

singlePhase.title: 7.4 kW charger
singlePhase.description: A full charge overnight for most vehicles. Works on a standard contract, with a load shedder so the meter never trips.

threePhase.title: 11 or 22 kW charger
threePhase.description: For two vehicles, heavy use or a three-phase solar installation. Charges 3 times faster, with dynamic power management.

chargingPark.title: Supervised charging park
chargingPark.description: Several 22 kW charging points on posts or walls, supervision and billing by a charge point operator, badge access, power sharing between chargers.

solarCharging.title: Fill up from your roof.
solarCharging.body: With surplus bought back at €0.01 per kWh, every kilowatt-hour sent to the grid is lost. The charger becomes the best consumer of your production: in solar mode it adjusts its power to the surplus and the vehicle charges during the day without buying anything. In the evening, the battery takes over.

example.title: Example: 12,000 km/year, 7 kW charger, 6 kWp of solar
example.note: Indicative estimate, refined during the study.

business.title: From underground car parks to vehicle fleets.
business.body: We equip shared car parks with a single scalable infrastructure: power riser, 22 kW chargers on posts or walls, supervision and badge billing. For businesses, fleet charging pairs with a solar carport or rooftop so you drive on the site's own energy.

condominium.imageAlt: Charging stations in a condominium underground car park
condominium.title: Condominium · underground car park
condominium.description: Shared infrastructure, spaces equipped on request, badge access

fleet.imageAlt: Fleet of electric vans charging in front of a company headquarters
fleet.title: Business · vehicle fleet
fleet.description: Charging at night or on solar surplus, tracking per vehicle

taxCredit.title: Smart charger tax credit (individuals)
taxCredit.description: For a smart charger installed by an IRVE-qualified installer in a main or second home. [Current amount, see glossary]

reducedVat.title: Reduced VAT
reducedVat.description: On installation in a home more than 2 years old.

advenir.title: Advenir programme (condominiums, businesses)
advenir.description: Grant for shared infrastructure and company car parks, subject to the programme's current conditions.

rightToPlug.title: Right to plug and LOM obligations
rightToPlug.description: Any condominium resident can have a charger installed; company car parks and new buildings must be pre-equipped according to their size.

reinforcedSocket.question: Isn't a reinforced socket enough?
reinforcedSocket.answer: It charges 3 times slower than a 7 kW charger and qualifies for no incentive. A charger also protects your electrical installation.

subscription.question: Do I need to change my electricity contract?
subscription.answer: Rarely: the load shedder adapts charging to the available power. We check this during the study.

timeline.question: How long does installation take?
timeline.answer: Quote within 48 h of the visit, installation within 2 to 3 weeks, in half a day to one day. No town hall paperwork.

compatibility.question: Is the charger compatible with my vehicle?
compatibility.answer: Yes, every charger we install uses a Type 2 socket, the European standard.

condominium.question: What about condominiums?
condominium.answer: We handle the notification to the property manager and offer an individual or shared solution depending on the car park.

pulsarPlus.description: Wall-mounted on the façade, dedicated breaker, app control

flayosc.description: Back to back on a stand, paired with 12 kWp + 6 kWh battery
flayosc.imageAlt: Wallbox charger on a post, vehicle plugged in

niceCondominium.title: Nice · condominium, 4 spaces
niceCondominium.description: Shared solution with badge · Advenir grant

cta.title: Technical visit and fixed quote within 48 h.
cta.body: Our electrician checks the switchboard, the power supply and the cable route, then gives you an all-inclusive quote.

premium.title: Fill up at home.
premium.lead: An elegant charger with controlled power. Our IRVE electricians install a solution suited to your vehicle, your home and your solar production, when available.
premium.imageAlt: Illustration of an electric vehicle charging outside a contemporary home at dusk
premium.caption: Electric mobility, at home in your architecture.

capture.label: Connect
capture.title: One connection. A whole system.
capture.body: The shell protects electronics that communicate with the vehicle. The Type 2 connector links the charger to the car for controlled charging.
capture.detail: The station controls power; the vehicle’s onboard charger converts current for its battery.

control.label: Manage
control.title: The right power at the right time.
control.body: With a compatible meter and control system, the charger adjusts its power to available energy. Solar mode prioritises surplus production from your panels.
control.detail: Grid power can supplement charging according to your chosen mode and available sunlight.

use.label: Drive
use.title: Your energy hits the road.
use.body: Energy reaches your vehicle’s battery. Schedule charging around departures, off-peak hours or your solar production.
use.detail: Charging sized around your installation and everyday habits.
